Varicent Rebate Engine – Domain Knowledge Document
1. Introduction
The Varicent Rebate Engine is a comprehensive incentive management platform designed to automate, manage, and optimize rebate and incentive programs for partners, distributors, and resellers. It helps organizations consolidate fragmented incentive programs into a single, unified framework. The engine enables accurate rebate calculation, eligibility checks, modeling, and payment processing across multiple geographies, sales channels, and partner types.
2. Business Purpose
The primary goal of the Varicent Rebate Engine is to modernize partner incentive programs by:
Unifying existing rebate and incentive programs under a single structure.
Rewarding partner performance through Value, Renewal, and Growth incentives.
Driving strategic goals such as recurring revenue, upsell, cross-sell, and new customer acquisition.
Providing predictable and transparent incentives to improve partner satisfaction.
Ensuring compliance and auditability through structured approval workflows and reporting.
3. Core Features
Flexible program setup with effective-dated rules and eligibility criteria.
Support for multiple incentive types – Value, Renewal, Growth, and Promotional incentives.
Calculation methods: uplift, multiplier, flat fee, and aggregated incentives.
Partner eligibility validation based on certifications, specializations, and Partner Value Score (PVS).
Ability to run 'what-if' modeling scenarios using historical and forecast data.
Dispute, override, and recoupment handling to maintain payout accuracy.
Integration with ERP, CRM, commerce, and Partner Experience systems for data synchronization.
Comprehensive reporting and dashboards for partners and internal stakeholders.
Multi-channel and geography support to ensure global fairness.
4. Key Entities
Rebate Program – High-level definition of incentive initiatives (e.g., Quarterly Volume Rebate).
Rebate Agreement – Partner-specific contract with terms and conditions.
Eligibility Flags – Indicators of partner certifications, specializations, or authorizations.
Partner Value Score (PVS) – A scoring mechanism used to determine eligibility and payout levels.

Transaction Data – Sales and purchase records used for rebate calculations.
Accruals – Financial reserves for expected incentive payouts.
Claims & Adjustments – Disputes, overrides, or recoupments processed within the system.
Payments – Final settlement of incentives, either as direct payments or credits.
5. Common Business Scenarios
A distributor receives a 3% rebate if quarterly purchases exceed 10,000 units.
A partner earns 2% rebate if sales grow by 10% year-over-year, or 5% rebate if growth exceeds 20%.
A partner earns Renewal incentives based on Annual Contract Value (ACV) performance.
Special promotional rebates are awarded for launching new product lines in a specific quarter.
Multi-channel rebates applied consistently across direct, reseller, and marketplace channels.
Recoupment applied if an order is cancelled or reduced below the rebate eligibility threshold.
6. Testing Challenges
Validating complex rule configurations and tiered eligibility criteria.
Ensuring rebate accruals align with financial reporting and ERP integration.
High-volume transaction processing performance testing.
Eligibility testing for partners with varying certifications and PVS scores.
Dispute, override, and recoupment handling under multiple scenarios.
Multi-currency and multi-geography validation for global partners.
7. Example Test Case Ideas
Verify rebate calculation for partners achieving threshold sales volume.
Validate Renewal incentive calculation based on ACV thresholds.
Test system behavior when a partner's PVS score moves from Low to High tier.
Validate handling of cancellations and recoupments on rebate payouts.
Check accuracy of 'what-if' modeling against historical data.
Verify partner dashboard shows correct earnings and eligibility in real-time.
Ensure consistency of rebate payouts across different sales channels.
Validate multi-currency rebate calculations for global regions.
